detailed_description:
The target video is live-action and cinematic, a hazy late-afternoon Manhattan avenue with glass towers and warm sunlight.
[Shot 1] A low-angle wide shot looks up a crowded avenue lined with skyscrapers, yellow taxis in the foreground. <Subject 1>, grown to the height of a six-storey building, walks slowly down the middle of the avenue toward the camera, her ginger hair and cross pendant swinging with each step, her expression curious as she looks around. Pedestrians run past the lens in panic and taxis swerve. The camera tilts up slowly to keep her in frame.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, the shot cuts to inside a taxi looking out through the rear side window: a passenger's hand holds up a phone recording her. Outside, beside the glass towers, the giant <Subject 1> turns her head and gazes up at the sky, a news helicopter hovering behind her.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to an extreme low angle from the street, looking up past her giant hip and arm: <Subject 1> places her palm flat against the glass facade of a skyscraper and looks up along it with quiet wonder, while two helicopters circle overhead against the pale sky. The camera holds a static shot.

overall_soundscape: City traffic and horns, people shouting and running, heavy ground-shaking footfalls, the muffled cabin sound and engine idle inside the taxi, then the chop of helicopter rotors overhead.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, awed orchestral swell with low strings and a distant choir.
